Load dataset

```{r read dataset}
DCM_RV <- readRDS(here::here("output", "QC_integration_annotation", "DCM_RV_RNA.rds"))
DefaultAssay(DCM_RV) <- "RNA"
DCM_RV$pseudobulk <- "pseudobulk"
```

Prepare metadata df

```{r}
metadata <- DCM_RV@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample:CO_l.min) %>%
  unique() %>%
  dplyr::select(-LVID_mm, -RVIT_mm) 
metadata <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::select(1:3, 5, 6, 4, 7:ncol(metadata)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(Sample, names(table(DCM_RV$Sample))))

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$Sample

all.equal(metadata$Sample, names(table(DCM_RV$Sample)))

reactable(metadata, 
          filterable = TRUE,
          searchable = TRUE,
          showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)

metadata_DCM <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::filter(Group == "DCM")
```

## DE pseudobulk all cells mPAP

```{r}
data <- subset(DCM_RV, mPAP_mmHg > 0)

expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(object = data, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
non_zero_cells <- rowSums(expr_matrix > 0)
total_cells <- ncol(expr_matrix)
percent_cells <- (non_zero_cells / total_cells) * 100
percent_stats <- data.frame(gene = rownames(expr_matrix), percentCells = percent_cells)

pseudocounts_mPAP <- Seurat2PB(data, sample="Sample", cluster = "pseudobulk")
colnames(pseudocounts_mPAP) <- pseudocounts_mPAP$samples$sample
```

```{r}
keep_genes <- rownames(dplyr::filter(percent_stats, percentCells > 1))
pseudocounts_mPAP <- pseudocounts_mPAP[keep_genes, ]

keep_samples <- pseudocounts_mPAP$samples$lib.size > 5e4
pseudocounts_mPAP <- pseudocounts_mPAP[, keep_samples]
keep_genes <- filterByExpr(pseudocounts_mPAP)
pseudocounts_mPAP <- pseudocounts_mPAP[keep_genes, ]
```

```{r DE_mPAP}
metadata_mPAP <- metadata_DCM[complete.cases(metadata_DCM[["mPAP_mmHg"]]),]
design <- model.matrix(~ metadata_mPAP[["mPAP_mmHg"]] + metadata_mPAP[["Age_years"]])
colnames(design)[2] <- "mPAP_mmHg"
colnames(design)[3] <- "Age_years"
design[,"mPAP_mmHg"] <- rescale(design[,"mPAP_mmHg"])

metadata_mPAP$Sample == pseudocounts_mPAP$samples$sample

pseudocounts_mPAP <- normLibSizes(pseudocounts_mPAP)
pseudocounts_mPAP <- estimateDisp(pseudocounts_mPAP, design)
  
fit <- glmQLFit(pseudocounts_mPAP, design, robust=TRUE)
fit <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = 2)
  
results_mPAP <- topTags(fit, n = Inf)$table
results_mPAP <- merge(results_mPAP, percent_stats[, c("gene", "percentCells")], by = "gene", all.x = FALSE)
results_mPAP$up_down <- ifelse(
  results_mPAP$logFC > 0.5 & results_mPAP$FDR < 0.1, "Increased",
    ifelse(results_mPAP$logFC < -0.5 & results_mPAP$FDR < 0.1, "Decreased",
           "Not significant"
           )
)

signif_mPAP <- results_mPAP %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.1, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(FDR)

write.csv(results_mPAP, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Results_DE_pseudobulk_allcells_mPAP.csv"), quote=F, row.names = F)
write.csv(signif_mPAP, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Signif_DE_pseudobulk_allcells_mPAP.csv"), quote=F, row.names = F)

rm(design, expr_matrix, fit, percent_stats, non_zero_cells, percent_cells, total_cells, keep_samples, keep_genes, data)
```

```{r counts_mPAP}
counts_mPAP <- cpm(pseudocounts_mPAP, log = TRUE)
```



```{r ann_col}
  arrange(mPAP_mmHg) %>%                   
  dplyr::select(mPAP_mmHg)                   

ann_colors <- list(

)
```

```{r Heatmap_DEGs_mPAP, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
counts_heatmap <- counts_heatmap[, metadata_heatmap$Sample, drop = FALSE]

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  name = " ",
  angle_col = "45",

  color = heatmap_cols,   
  scale = "row",
```

```{r Heatmap_DEGs_mPAP_clustered, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
  fontsize = 10,
  fontsize_row = 13,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  cellheight = 0.1,
  gaps_col = c(0,0,0)
  )
```

```{r Volcano_all_mPAP, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=3.5}
keyvals <- rep("grey", nrow(results_mPAP))
names(keyvals) <- rep("Not significant", nrow(results_mPAP))
keyvals[results_mPAP$logFC > 0.5 & results_mPAP$FDR < 0.1] <- "#A63A2A"
names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#A63A2A"] <- "Increased"
keyvals[results_mPAP$logFC < -0.5 & results_mPAP$FDR < 0.1] <- "#004C8C"
names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#004C8C"] <- "Decreased"

volcano <- EnhancedVolcano(results_mPAP,
                           lab = results_mPAP$gene,
                           x = "logFC",
                           y = "FDR",
                           labSize = 0,
                           titleLabSize = 16,
                           subtitleLabSize = 14,
                           axisLabSize = 12,
                           captionLabSize = 9,
                           pointSize = 0.5,
                           FCcutoff = 0.5,
                           pCutoff  = 0.1,
                           ylim = c(0, 3.5),
                           colCustom = keyvals,
                           colAlpha = 1,
                           drawConnectors = FALSE,
                           subtitle = NULL,
                           title = "Pseudobulk all cells\nmPAP (n = 18)"
                           ) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")
volcano
```


## DE pseudobulk all cells DCM vs HC

```{r}
data <- DCM_RV

expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(object = data, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
non_zero_cells <- rowSums(expr_matrix > 0)
total_cells <- ncol(expr_matrix)
percent_cells <- (non_zero_cells / total_cells) * 100
percent_stats <- data.frame(gene = rownames(expr_matrix), percentCells = percent_cells)

pseudocounts_all <- Seurat2PB(data, sample="Sample", cluster = "pseudobulk")
colnames(pseudocounts_all) <- pseudocounts_all$samples$sample
```

```{r}
keep_genes <- rownames(dplyr::filter(percent_stats, percentCells > 1))
pseudocounts_all <- pseudocounts_all[keep_genes, ]

keep_samples <- pseudocounts_all$samples$lib.size > 5e4
pseudocounts_all <- pseudocounts_all[, keep_samples]
keep_genes <- filterByExpr(pseudocounts_all)
pseudocounts_all <- pseudocounts_all[keep_genes, ]
```

```{r}
group <- factor(metadata$Group)
levels(group)

design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
colnames(design) <- levels(group)

contrast <- makeContrasts(
  DCM_vs_HC = DCM - HC,
  levels = design
)

metadata$Sample == pseudocounts_all$samples$sample

pseudocounts_all <- normLibSizes(pseudocounts_all)
pseudocounts_all <- estimateDisp(pseudocounts_all, design)
  
fit <- glmQLFit(pseudocounts_all, design, robust=TRUE)
fit <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast)
  
results_DCM_HC <- topTags(fit, n = Inf)$table
results_DCM_HC <- merge(results_DCM_HC, percent_stats[, c("gene", "percentCells")], by = "gene", all.x = FALSE)
results_DCM_HC$up_down <- ifelse(
  results_DCM_HC$logFC > 0.5 & results_DCM_HC$FDR < 0.1, "Increased",
    ifelse(results_DCM_HC$logFC < -0.5 & results_DCM_HC$FDR < 0.1, "Decreased",
           "Not significant"
           )
)
signif_DCM_HC <- results_DCM_HC %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.1, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(FDR)

write.csv(results_DCM_HC, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Results_DE_pseudobulk_allcells_DCM_HC.csv"), quote=F, row.names = F)
write.csv(signif_DCM_HC, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Signif_DE_pseudobulk_allcells_DCM_HC.csv"), quote=F, row.names = F)

rm(design, expr_matrix, fit, percent_stats, non_zero_cells, percent_cells, total_cells, keep_samples, keep_genes, data)
```


## Plasma proteome

```{r}
Plasma_proteome_atlas <- read_excel(path = here::here("data", "Human_plasma_proteome.xlsx"), sheet = 1)
Plasma_proteome_concentration <- read_excel(path = here::here("data", "Human_plasma_proteome.xlsx"), sheet = 2)

signif_mPAP$Detected_in_plasma <- ifelse(signif_mPAP$gene %in% Plasma_proteome_concentration$Gene, "Yes", "No")

table(filter(signif_mPAP, diff_exp_in_HC == "Yes")$Detected_in_plasma)
```


## Heart specific proteome

```{r}
Heart_proteome_atlas <- read_excel(path = here::here("data", "Heart_specific_proteome.xlsx"), sheet = 1)

signif_mPAP$Heart_specific <- ifelse(signif_mPAP$gene %in% Heart_proteome_atlas$Gene, "Yes", "No")

table(filter(signif_mPAP, diff_exp_in_HC == "Yes" & Detected_in_plasma == "Yes")$Heart_specific)
```

## DE LV datasets

### Koenig 2022

```{r Import Koenig}
load("/scratch/gbonaz/Heart_datasets/Koenig_2022/GSE183852_DCM_Nuclei.Robj")
Koenig <- nuclei
rm(nuclei)
```

```{r subset Koenig}
Koenig$pseudobulk <- "pseudobulk"
```

```{r add metadata Koenig}
Clinical_data <- read_excel("/scratch/gbonaz/Heart_datasets/Koenig_2022/Koenig_et_al_2022_Selected_clinical_info.xlsx")
add_metadata <- left_join(Koenig[["orig.ident"]], Clinical_data)
row.names(add_metadata) <- row.names(Koenig[[]])
Koenig <- AddMetaData(Koenig, metadata = add_metadata)
rm(add_metadata, Clinical_data)
Koenig$Group <- Koenig$Condition
Koenig$Sample <- Koenig$orig.ident
```

```{r metadata Koenig}
metadata_Koenig <- Koenig@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Age, Sex, Group, Pre_Op_EF, Pre_Op_CO_L_min, HTN) %>%
  unique()

rownames(metadata_Koenig) <- metadata_Koenig$Sample

reactable(metadata_Koenig, 
          filterable = TRUE,
          searchable = TRUE,
          showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
```

```{r}
data <- Koenig

expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(object = data, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
non_zero_cells <- rowSums(expr_matrix > 0)
total_cells <- ncol(expr_matrix)
percent_cells <- (non_zero_cells / total_cells) * 100
percent_stats <- data.frame(gene = rownames(expr_matrix), percentCells = percent_cells)

pseudocounts_Koenig <- Seurat2PB(data, sample="Sample", cluster = "pseudobulk")
colnames(pseudocounts_Koenig) <- pseudocounts_Koenig$samples$sample
```

```{r}
keep_genes <- rownames(dplyr::filter(percent_stats, percentCells > 1))
pseudocounts_Koenig <- pseudocounts_Koenig[keep_genes, ]

keep_samples <- pseudocounts_Koenig$samples$lib.size > 5e4
pseudocounts_Koenig <- pseudocounts_Koenig[, keep_samples]
keep_genes <- filterByExpr(pseudocounts_Koenig)
pseudocounts_Koenig <- pseudocounts_Koenig[keep_genes, ]
```

```{r DE_Koenig}
metadata_Koenig <- metadata_Koenig[
  match(pseudocounts_Koenig$samples$sample, metadata_Koenig$Sample),
]

group <- factor(metadata_Koenig$Group)
levels(group)

design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
colnames(design) <- levels(group)

contrast <- makeContrasts(
  DCM_vs_HC = DCM - Donor,
  levels = design
)

metadata_Koenig$Sample == pseudocounts_Koenig$samples$sample

pseudocounts_Koenig <- normLibSizes(pseudocounts_Koenig)
pseudocounts_Koenig <- estimateDisp(pseudocounts_Koenig, design)
  
fit <- glmQLFit(pseudocounts_Koenig, design, robust=TRUE)
fit <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast)
  
results_Koenig <- topTags(fit, n = Inf)$table
results_Koenig <- merge(results_Koenig, percent_stats[, c("gene", "percentCells")], by = "gene", all.x = FALSE)
results_Koenig$up_down <- ifelse(
  results_Koenig$logFC > 0.5 & results_Koenig$FDR < 0.1, "Increased",
    ifelse(results_Koenig$logFC < -0.5 & results_Koenig$FDR < 0.1, "Decreased",
           "Not significant"
           )
)
signif_Koenig <- results_Koenig %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.1, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(FDR)

write.csv(results_Koenig, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Results_DE_pseudobulk_Koenig.csv"), quote=F, row.names = F)
write.csv(signif_Koenig, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Signif_DE_pseudobulk_Koenig.csv"), quote=F, row.names = F)

rm(design, expr_matrix, fit, percent_stats, non_zero_cells, percent_cells, total_cells, keep_samples, keep_genes, data)
```

```{r add metadata Reichart}
Clinical_data <- read_excel("/scratch/gbonaz/Heart_datasets/Reichart_2022/Reichart_et_al_Science_2022_Selected_clinical_info.xlsx")
add_metadata <- left_join(Reichart[["donor_id"]], Clinical_data)

Reichart@meta.data[Reichart@meta.data$disease == "normal", "Group"] = "HC"
Reichart@meta.data[Reichart@meta.data$disease == "dilated cardiomyopathy", "Group"] = "DCM"
Reichart$Sample <- Reichart$donor_id
```


```{r metadata Reichart}
metadata_Reichart <- Reichart@meta.data %>%
   dplyr::select(Sample, Group, sex, Age_range, LVEF_percent, LVIDd_mm, LVIDs_mm, RVEDD_mm, TAPSE_mm, PAH, Hypertension, COPD) %>%
  unique()

rownames(metadata_Reichart) <- metadata_Reichart$Sample

reactable(metadata_Reichart, 
          filterable = TRUE,
          searchable = TRUE,
          showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
```

```{r}
data <- Reichart

expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(object = data, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
non_zero_cells <- rowSums(expr_matrix > 0)
total_cells <- ncol(expr_matrix)
percent_cells <- (non_zero_cells / total_cells) * 100
percent_stats <- data.frame(gene = rownames(expr_matrix), percentCells = percent_cells)

pseudocounts_Reichart <- Seurat2PB(data, sample="Sample", cluster = "pseudobulk")
colnames(pseudocounts_Reichart) <- pseudocounts_Reichart$samples$sample
```

```{r}
keep_genes <- rownames(dplyr::filter(percent_stats, percentCells > 1))
pseudocounts_Reichart <- pseudocounts_Reichart[keep_genes, ]

keep_samples <- pseudocounts_Reichart$samples$lib.size > 5e4
pseudocounts_Reichart <- pseudocounts_Reichart[, keep_samples]
keep_genes <- filterByExpr(pseudocounts_Reichart)
pseudocounts_Reichart <- pseudocounts_Reichart[keep_genes, ]
```

```{r DE_Reichart}
metadata_Reichart <- metadata_Reichart[
  match(pseudocounts_Reichart$samples$sample, metadata_Reichart$Sample),
]

group <- factor(metadata_Reichart$Group)
levels(group)

design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
colnames(design) <- levels(group)

contrast <- makeContrasts(
  DCM_vs_HC = DCM - HC,
  levels = design
)

metadata_Reichart$Sample == pseudocounts_Reichart$samples$sample

pseudocounts_Reichart <- normLibSizes(pseudocounts_Reichart)
pseudocounts_Reichart <- estimateDisp(pseudocounts_Reichart, design)
  
fit <- glmQLFit(pseudocounts_Reichart, design, robust=TRUE)
fit <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast)
  
results_Reichart <- topTags(fit, n = Inf)$table
results_Reichart <- merge(results_Reichart, percent_stats[, c("gene", "percentCells")], by = "gene", all.x = FALSE)
results_Reichart$up_down <- ifelse(
  results_Reichart$logFC > 0.5 & results_Reichart$FDR < 0.1, "Increased",
    ifelse(results_Reichart$logFC < -0.5 & results_Reichart$FDR < 0.1, "Decreased",
           "Not significant"
           )
)
results_Reichart <- results_Reichart %>%
  dplyr::select(-feature_biotype, -feature_is_filtered, -feature_name, -feature_reference, -feature_length)

signif_Reichart <- results_Reichart %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.1, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(FDR)

write.csv(results_Reichart, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Results_DE_pseudobulk_Reichart.csv"), quote=F, row.names = F)
write.csv(signif_Reichart, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Signif_DE_pseudobulk_Reichart.csv"), quote=F, row.names = F)

rm(design, expr_matrix, fit, percent_stats, non_zero_cells, percent_cells, total_cells, keep_samples, keep_genes, data)
```

## Correct gene names

```{r gn_Koenig}
results_Koenig$Compatible_gene_symbol <- ifelse(
  results_Koenig$gene %in% rownames(DCM_RV), "TRUE",
  "FALSE"
)
table(results_Koenig$Compatible_gene_symbol)
signif_Koenig$Compatible_gene_symbol <- ifelse(
  signif_Koenig$gene %in% rownames(DCM_RV), "TRUE",
  "FALSE"
)
table(signif_Koenig$Compatible_gene_symbol)

print("Gene symbols have to be converted")
```


```{r gn_Reichart}
results_Reichart$Compatible_gene_symbol <- ifelse(
  results_Reichart$gene %in% rownames(DCM_RV), "TRUE",
  "FALSE"
)
table(results_Reichart$Compatible_gene_symbol)
signif_Reichart$Compatible_gene_symbol <- ifelse(
  signif_Reichart$gene %in% rownames(DCM_RV), "TRUE",
  "FALSE"
```

```{r gn_Chaffin}
results_Chaffin$Compatible_gene_symbol <- ifelse(
  results_Chaffin$gene %in% rownames(DCM_RV), "TRUE",
  "FALSE"
)
table(results_Chaffin$Compatible_gene_symbol)
signif_Chaffin$Compatible_gene_symbol <- ifelse(
  signif_Chaffin$gene %in% rownames(DCM_RV), "TRUE",
  "FALSE"

table(signif_Chaffin$Compatible_gene_symbol)

print("Gene symbols don't have to be converted")
```

```{r DE_Koenig convert gene_names}
# Step 1: Connect to the Ensembl GRCh37 BioMart database
grch37 <- useEnsembl(
  biomart = "genes",
  dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl",
  GRCh = 37
)

# Step 2: Convert GRCh37 gene symbols to Ensembl IDs
gene_list <- results_Koenig$gene

# Query BioMart to get Ensembl Gene IDs for the GRCh37 gene symbols
grch37_gene_ids <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "external_gene_name"), 
                         filters = "external_gene_name", 
                         values = gene_list, 
                         mart = grch37)

# Identify unmatched genes
unmapped_genes <- setdiff(gene_list, grch37_gene_ids$external_gene_name)

# Step 5: Use the GRCh38 reference GTF file (from refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A) to match Ensembl IDs
reference_genes <- readGFF(here::here("data", "refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A", "genes", "genes.gtf"))

# dplyr::filter only gene-level annotations and select relevant columns
reference_gene_mapping <- reference_genes %>%
  dplyr::filter(type == "gene") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_name)

# Match the Ensembl IDs from GRCh37 with the GRCh38 reference
matched_genes_grch38 <- reference_gene_mapping %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_id %in% grch37_gene_ids$ensembl_gene_id)

unmatched_genes <- setdiff(grch37_gene_ids$ensembl_gene_id, matched_genes_grch38$gene_id) #Contains multiple ensembl gene ids from the same gene symbol

# Join the data with GRCh37 Ensembl IDs and GRCh38 gene names
results_Koenig <- results_Koenig %>%
  left_join(grch37_gene_ids, by = c("gene" = "external_gene_name")) %>%
  left_join(reference_gene_mapping, by = c("ensembl_gene_id" = "gene_id"))

# Prefer rows with non-NA gene_name
results_Koenig <- results_Koenig %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(!is.na(gene_name))) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Check compatibility again after conversion
results_Koenig$Compatible_gene_symbol <- ifelse(results_Koenig$gene_name %in% rownames(DCM_RV), "TRUE", "FALSE")
table(results_Koenig$Compatible_gene_symbol)

results_Koenig$Gene_name_conversion <- ifelse(results_Koenig$gene %in% unmapped_genes, "Unmapped to GRCh37", 
                                         ifelse(results_Koenig$ensembl_gene_id %in% unmatched_genes, "Not matched to GRCh38", 
                                                ifelse(results_Koenig$Compatible_gene_symbol == "TRUE", "Conversion OK", 
                                                       "Not present in DCM_RV")))

signif_Koenig <- results_Koenig %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.1, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(FDR)

table(signif_Koenig$Compatible_gene_symbol)

table(signif_Koenig$Gene_name_conversion)

print("Results are acceptable")

rm(grch37, gene_list, grch37_gene_ids, unmapped_genes, matched_genes_grch38, unmatched_genes)
```

```{r DE_Reichart convert gene_names}
results_Reichart <- left_join(results_Reichart, Reichart_gene_names, by = c("gene" = "gene_symbol"))

unmatched_genes <- setdiff(results_Reichart$ensembl_id, reference_gene_mapping$gene_id)

length(unmatched_genes)

results_Reichart <- left_join(results_Reichart, reference_gene_mapping, by = c("ensembl_id" = "gene_id"))
  
# Check compatibility again after conversion
```

```{r Correlation plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
# Merge the datasets by a common column, e.g., gene
merged_data <- results_Koenig %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC_Koenig = logFC) %>%
  inner_join(results_Chaffin %>% dplyr::select(gene, logFC_Chaffin = logFC), by = "gene") %>%
  inner_join(results_Reichart %>% dplyr::select(gene, logFC_Reichart = logFC), by = "gene") %>%
  inner_join(results_DCM_HC %>% dplyr::select(gene, logFC_RV = logFC), by = "gene")

# Create a pairwise scatterplot with correlations
ggpairs(
  merged_data %>% dplyr::select(-gene), # Exclude the gene column for plotting
  lower = list(continuous = wrap("smooth", method = "lm")), # Add linear fit
  diag = list(continuous = "densityDiag"), # Density plot on diagonal
  upper = list(continuous = wrap("cor", size = 4)) # Correlation and p-value in upper triangle
) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r UpSet_plot_intersect, fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
gene_sets_up <- list(
  DCM_RV = dplyr::filter(signif_DCM_HC, logFC > 0)$gene,
  Chaffin = dplyr::filter(signif_Chaffin, logFC > 0)$gene,
  Koenig = dplyr::filter(signif_Koenig, logFC > 0)$gene,
  Reichart = dplyr::filter(signif_Reichart, logFC > 0)$gene
)
gene_sets_up <- lapply(gene_sets_up, function(x) x[!is.na(x)])

m <- make_comb_mat(gene_sets_up, mode = "intersect", min_set_size = 1)
p1 <- UpSet(m, column_title = "Upregulated genes - intersect", comb_order = order(comb_size(m)), 
                    top_annotation = upset_top_annotation(m, add_numbers = TRUE),
                    right_annotation = upset_right_annotation(m, add_numbers = TRUE))

gene_sets_down <- list(
  DCM_RV = dplyr::filter(signif_DCM_HC, logFC < 0)$gene,
  Chaffin = dplyr::filter(signif_Chaffin, logFC < 0)$gene,
  Koenig = dplyr::filter(signif_Chaffin, logFC < 0)$gene,
  Reichart = dplyr::filter(signif_Reichart, logFC < 0)$gene
)
gene_sets_down <- lapply(gene_sets_down, function(x) x[!is.na(x)])

m <- make_comb_mat(gene_sets_down, mode = "intersect")
p2 <- UpSet(m, column_title = "Downregulated genes - intersect", comb_order = order(comb_size(m)), 
                    top_annotation = upset_top_annotation(m, add_numbers = TRUE),
                    right_annotation = upset_right_annotation(m, add_numbers = TRUE))

p1 <- grid::grid.grabExpr(draw(p1))
p2 <- grid::grid.grabExpr(draw(p2))

combined_plots <- plot_grid(p1, p2, ncol = 1)

print(combined_plots)
rm(m, p1, p2, combined_plots)
```

```{r UpSet_plot_distinct, fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
m <- make_comb_mat(gene_sets_up, mode = "distinct", min_set_size = 1)
p1 <- UpSet(m, column_title = "Upregulated genes - distinct", comb_order = order(comb_size(m)), 
                    top_annotation = upset_top_annotation(m, add_numbers = TRUE),
                    right_annotation = upset_right_annotation(m, add_numbers = TRUE))

m <- make_comb_mat(gene_sets_down, mode = "distinct")
p2 <- UpSet(m, column_title = "Downregulated genes - distinct", comb_order = order(comb_size(m)), 
                    top_annotation = upset_top_annotation(m, add_numbers = TRUE),
                    right_annotation = upset_right_annotation(m, add_numbers = TRUE))

p1 <- grid::grid.grabExpr(draw(p1))
p2 <- grid::grid.grabExpr(draw(p2))

combined_plots <- plot_grid(p1, p2, ncol = 1)

print(combined_plots)
rm(m, p1, p2, combined_plots)
```


## Filter for dysregulated in LV

```{r}
signif_mPAP$Koenig <- ifelse(signif_mPAP$logFC > 0 & signif_mPAP$gene %in% dplyr::filter(signif_Koenig, logFC > 0)$gene, "Upregulated",
                                   ifelse(signif_mPAP$logFC < 0 & signif_mPAP$gene %in% dplyr::filter(signif_Koenig, logFC < 0)$gene, "Downregulated", "Not significant"))

signif_mPAP$Chaffin <- ifelse(signif_mPAP$logFC > 0 & signif_mPAP$gene %in% dplyr::filter(signif_Chaffin, logFC > 0)$gene, "Upregulated",
                                   ifelse(signif_mPAP$logFC < 0 & signif_mPAP$gene %in% dplyr::filter(signif_Chaffin, logFC < 0)$gene, "Downregulated", "Not significant"))

signif_mPAP$Reichart <- ifelse(signif_mPAP$logFC > 0 & signif_mPAP$gene %in% dplyr::filter(signif_Reichart, logFC > 0)$gene, "Upregulated",
                                   ifelse(signif_mPAP$logFC < 0 & signif_mPAP$gene %in% dplyr::filter(signif_Reichart, logFC < 0)$gene, "Downregulated", "Not significant"))
```

```{r}
reactable(signif_mPAP, 
          filterable = TRUE,
          searchable = TRUE,
          showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
```

```{r candidate_biomarkers}
candidate_biomarkers <- signif_mPAP %>%
  dplyr::filter(diff_exp_in_HC == "Yes") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Detected_in_plasma == "Yes") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Heart_specific == "Yes") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(n_not_sig = sum(c(Koenig, Chaffin, Reichart) == "Not significant")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_not_sig >= 2) %>%
  arrange(desc(logFC))

nrow(candidate_biomarkers)
reactable(candidate_biomarkers, 
          filterable = TRUE,
          searchable = TRUE,
          showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
```
